{{Quote|Commander, what is the damage level to the enemy ship?''"<br />"''She's lost her primary shields and stabilizers, but the ship is so massive, it can take all the fire our cannons can give it.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and the commander|<ref name="dm" />}}
A '''[[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]]''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they were under command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and participated in the hunting and destruction of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]], the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].<ref name="dm" />
